If you are a resident of Cook County, Illinois and are facing legal issues, the Cook County Circuit Court is where you can find justice. With numerous locations in the county, one of the main courthouses is located at 3199 W Flournoy St. This article will provide you with an overview of the Cook County Circuit Court and specifically the 3199 W Flournoy St location.

Understanding the Cook County Circuit Court

The Cook County Circuit Court is the largest unified court system in the United States, serving over 5.2 million residents of Cook County. It has over 400 judges and is responsible for hearing both civil and criminal cases. The Circuit Court has numerous locations throughout the county, with the main courthouses being located in Chicago.

Different Types of Cases Heard in the Cook County Circuit Court

The Cook County Circuit Court hears a wide variety of cases, including:

  • Criminal cases
  • Civil cases
  • Domestic relations cases
  • Juvenile justice cases
  • Probate cases
  • Traffic cases

Cook County Circuit Court: 3199 W Flournoy St Location

The 3199 W Flournoy St location of the Cook County Circuit Court is one of the busiest courthouses in the county. It primarily handles criminal cases, but also handles some civil cases. The courthouse is open from Monday to Friday, from 8:30 am to 4:30 pm.

Services Available at Cook County Circuit Court: 3199 W Flournoy St

The 3199 W Flournoy St location of the Cook County Circuit Court offers a wide range of services to the public, including:

  • Case information and records
  • Courtroom assignments and schedules
  • Payment of fines and fees
  • Access to legal self-help centers
  • Access to the Clerk of the Circuit Court

What to Expect When Visiting the 3199 W Flournoy St Location

If you need to visit the 3199 W Flournoy St location of the Cook County Circuit Court, it is important to arrive early as lines can be long. You will be required to go through security screening before entering the courthouse, so be sure to leave any prohibited items at home.

Once inside, you can check the courtroom schedule to find out when and where your case will be heard. If you need to pay fines or fees, you can do so at the payment center located on the first floor.

Hiring a Lawyer for Your Case

If you are facing legal issues and need representation, it is important to hire a qualified lawyer. The Chicago Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service can help you find a lawyer who is right for your case.

Conclusion

The Cook County Circuit Court is a crucial part of the justice system in Cook County, Illinois. The 3199 W Flournoy St location is one of the busiest courthouses in the county, primarily handling criminal cases. If you need to visit this courthouse, arrive early and be prepared to go through security screening. Remember to leave prohibited items at home and pay any fines or fees at the payment center located on the first floor.
